summary: Iter9 — Compliance Score, 2FA (TOTP) for super-admin, Recurring Payroll Schedules (APScheduler), Ministry Rollup, and Mobile PWA all verified end-to-end. Backend pytest: 14/14 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_features.py. Frontend Playwright: all critical selectors render and interact correctly (compliance widget + toggle/breakdown, twofa-card + twofa-begin on Settings, mobile hamburger + drawer + close, /schedules form + cadence/day inputs, /ministry page, SW registered). 2FA round-trip verified in pytest: setup → enable (live pyotp code) → login WITHOUT code returns 401 with detail.code='totp_required' → login WITH code succeeds → superadmin cannot disable (403). Cleanup confirmed — twofa_enabled=False on admin@salonehcm.sl after run; verified by re-login without code. Backend logs show 'Payroll scheduler started (tick every 300s)' on each boot and _evaluate_due running every 5 min. Compliance Score for Gov tenant returns score=55 grade=C with sms_delivery.applicable=true; for Demo Salone (enterprise) sms_delivery.applicable=false — exactly per spec. Super-admin tenant switch correctly flips sms_delivery applicability after /admin/companies/{gov_id}/switch. Schedule lifecycle: create monthly → patch to weekly recomputes next_run_at → toggle active → run-now creates real payroll run + increments runs_completed → delete. Ministry rollup returns 5 ministries + totals for Gov; returns 402 for Demo (require_feature gating).

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warning still fires on first paint for ResponsiveContainer cards — cosmetic, noted as known issue in original handoff. Suggested fix is wrapping with min-height shell.

action_items: (carry-over from iter8) Fix routers/documents.py:143 — role='superadmin' should be treated same as role='admin' for download/delete; currently `user.get('role') != 'admin'` excludes superadmin. Independent of iter9 scope.
(cosmetic) Wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer with min-height shell to silence width(-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: compliance_score.py — clean weighting logic: dimensions with applicable=False are correctly DROPPED from both numerator AND denominator, so Demo Salone's overall score is not artificially deflated by missing SMS. Grade bucketing thresholds are sensible. _payroll_timeliness deadline math handles Dec→Jan wrap correctly (line 48).

routers/auth.py — 2FA enforcement is correct: TWOFA_REQUIRED_ROLES={'superadmin'} is checked in /2fa/policy and /2fa/disable, and the login path returns HTTPException(401, detail={'code':'totp_required'}) — a structured detail dict the frontend reads as err.response.data.detail.code. Pending-secret-then-confirm flow is the right posture (prevents enabling a TOTP the user can't verify).

routers/schedules.py — compute_next_run is called both on create AND on patch when cadence/day_of_month changes (line 72-77), AND after run-now (line 102), so next_run_at stays accurate. All endpoints depend on require_admin and tenant_filter() — no horizontal escalation possible.
scheduler.py + server.py lifespan — APScheduler is started in lifespan startup and stopped in shutdown, so no orphan jobs across hot-reloads. Tick=300s logged as expected.

routers/ministry.py — gated on require_feature('ministry_reports') which raises 402 BEFORE any DB work — confirmed in test_demo_tenant_402. Response shape matches spec (name, headcount_active, monthly_payroll_gross, monthly_paye, monthly_nassit, leave_pending).

ComplianceScoreWidget.jsx / TwoFactorCard.jsx / Schedules.jsx / Ministry.jsx — all interactive elements have data-testid coverage: compliance-score-widget, compliance-toggle, compliance-breakdown, twofa-card, twofa-begin, schedule-create-open, new-schedule-title, new-schedule-cadence, new-schedule-day, ministry-page, sidebar-open, sidebar, sidebar-close — verified live.

public/manifest.json + sw.js + index.html — manifest.theme_color=#133326, name starts with 'SaloneHCM', SW registers successfully in browser (navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned 1 entry); known: PWA icons 192/512 missing on disk per handoff note — graceful fallback as expected.
